column1: # kit retro-sections registry (read by the kit's retro_sections.py):
#   <module>\t<command>[\t<lanes>]
# The reader ships with kit_life 2.28.0 (database/retro_sections.py); the
# optional third column (lanes: morning|daily|weekly|grid) with kit_life
# 2.38.0. A row without it serves daily,weekly (the 2.28 contract). A
# pre-2.38 reader takes the lanes column as an argument, so the provider
# refuses it and that row is skipped with one stderr line (fail-open); the
# release that ships these rows requires kit_life >=2.38.0. Rows run in FILE
# ORDER, so the order below is the card's order: each slot's tail row
# (the next session, the next-week proposal -- the one decision) comes last.
# Weekly (the domain weekly, kit weekly-review.sh): sessions vs plan, body
# trend, goal check (<= 3 lines, no decision); also the Mon..Sun grid rows.
module_health
# The weekly muscle facts: at most 3 lines, no decision or offer writes; silent
# (exit 3) on a week with no training and on the daily lane.
module_health
# Morning (kit morning-brief.sh domain path): this week so far, today's
# session, today's diet target. Rest day: no session line.
module_health
# Daily glance card (kit daily-retro.sh domain path): today's session vs its
# plan, intake vs target.
module_health
# The daily protein line (diet-status/protein.py via protein-retro): one line,
# no decision; silent (exit 3) on the weekly lane, a day with no meal rows or
# no stored weight.
module_health
# Daily tail: "내일 운동: <day> · <time>" -- only on a card that has a day.
module_health
# Weekly tail: the next-week placement proposal, the weekly's one decision.
module_health
